units.source_text: 打昭和三十一年起，就让斋王 [1] 加入了葵节的敕使队伍。

en.t: Starting in Showa 31, the Saio was included in the imperial envoy's procession for the Aoi Festival.

units.source_text: 这是古时候的一种仪式，相传斋王在隐居斋院之前，要在加茂川把身体洗净。

en.t: This was an ancient ritual; it is said that before withdrawing to the Saiin, the Saio purified her body in the Kamo River.

units.source_text: 由坐在轿子上、身穿便礼服的女官领先，女嬬 [2] 和童女等随后，乐师奏着雅乐，

en.t: A court lady seated in a palanquin and dressed in formal attire led the way, followed by lower-ranking female attendants and young girls, while musicians played gagaku court music,

units.source_text: 斋王则穿一身十二单衣坐在牛车上，游行过去。

en.t: and the Saio, wearing a full twelve-layered robe, rode past in an ox carriage as part of the procession.

units.source_text: 由于这身装束，加上斋王是由女大学生年纪的人装扮，所以看上去更加风雅华丽。

en.t: Because of that costume, and because the Saio was portrayed by someone about the age of a female university student, she looked all the more elegant and splendid.
